records.title: Backdoors in RLVR: Jailbreak Backdoors in LLMs From Verifiable Reward
records.reason: The paper studies/verifies RLVR jailbreak backdoors and safety behavior, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Guiding a Diffusion Transformer with the Internal Dynamics of Itself
records.reason: Internal Guidance trains and guides diffusion transformers for image generation and reports image FID/training-resource gains. The architecture and evaluated workload are image diffusion transformers, not LLM inference, KV/cache, quantization, or serving.

records.title: Incentivizing Parametric Knowledge via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Cross-Cultural Entity Translation
records.reason: The contribution is reward-based cross-cultural entity translation post-training and translation quality; no inference-time efficiency technique is described.

records.title: SHAPE: Stage-aware Hierarchical Advantage via Potential Estimation for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: The paper proposes stage-aware process supervision for LLM reasoning training; its target is training signals, not inference cost or serving.

records.title: Mitigating Selection Bias in Large Language Models via Permutation-Aware GRPO
records.reason: Permutation-aware GRPO addresses option-position selection bias during model training/evaluation, not inference compute or serving.
